+Clinical
Privacy policy

A private app for Bitehaus Dental Clinic

Patient records.
A clear schedule.

Clinical is an iOS app for the clinic’s primary dentist. It keeps patient details, appointments, and unavailable time together on the device.

Clinical is provided for private use. This website contains app information only. It does not display patient records or accept Google account connections.

01 / THE APP

Clinic data stays under
the user’s control.

Clinical stores patient and schedule records in a local database. Its iOS widget shows the schedule. With permission, the app uses Contacts and keeps linked appointment events in Apple Calendar.

02 / GOOGLE DRIVE BACKUPS

A backup in the
connected Google account.

The Google Drive backup feature saves database snapshots in an unshared Clinical Backups folder. Google authorization is limited to the files Clinical creates and the account details needed to identify the connected account.
